original:
Let $\Sigma$ be a connected signed graph on $n\geq 2$ vertices whose negative edges are incident to a common vertex $u$ .
Suppose that $\Sigma$ has no balanced block. Then

 $Z_{\Sigma}(1)=(-1)^{n+1}b_{\Sigma},\;\;\text{where }\;b_{\Sigma}=\prod_{B:\text{ a block of }\Sigma}\beta(H_{u}(B))\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}.$ 

Consequently, the coefficients in (2.4) satisfy

 $\begin{array}[]{lll}n\text{ even}:&h_{2}\leq-1,&h_{3}\geq n+1,\\[2.0pt]
n\text{ odd}:&h_{2}\geq 1,&h_{3}\leq 1-n.\end{array}$ 

In particular, $h_{\Sigma}(t)$ has a negative coefficient.
